Cultivated meat, also known as cultured meat, is genuine animal meat produced by cultivating animal cells in a safe and controlled environment.

[The Good Food Institute](https://gfi.org/science/the-science-of-cultivated-meat/) explains that the manufacturing process begins with acquiring and banking stem cells from an animal. These cells are then grown in bioreactors (known colloquially as [cultivators](https://gfi.org/cultivated/)) at high densities and volumes.
